# Utkarsh Raj

> Utkarsh Raj is a Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) student at Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (SSCBS), University of Delhi, from Bhagalpur, Bihar. National Rank 3 at the IIT Delhi Startup Expo case competition, AIR 4 in the National Consulting Olympiad 2025, AIR 109 in CUET UG 2026, and an admit to IIM Bangalore's B.Sc. (Hons.) Data Science programme.

This is the official site of the Utkarsh Raj who studies BMS at SSCBS, University of Delhi (2026 to 2029) and grew up in Bhagalpur, Bihar.
